value_leaf_table.derivation: PLAY SCALARS use only in-play depths (<= h_conv_depth_cap): h_conv = min heuristic_lp over those; value_trust_depth = min{d<=cap: value_leaf_lp[d]-h_conv <= tol}; value_no_fallback likewise. (Deep cells d>cap extend the table+crossover for the anchor but do NOT move the escalation gate; a trust_depth > search_depth is equivalent to UNSET in play.) crossover spans ALL depths.

value_fallback_crossover.rule: after escalating a value-leaf line committed at depth c, TAKE the heuristic line iff hcommitted >= take_heuristic_at_hdepth[c] (else keep the leaf). Clamp c/hcommitted to the measured [min,max] depth. Per-committed-depth (NOT a uniform offset).

provenance.note: eval_model retrained on rows dumped at SHIPPED play WITH the deck profile, so the exhaustive keep model was live. Labels are searched K=3 for every deck (a pooled dump forces one label mode). value_leaf_table/crossover are the REGENERATED 400-game x 4-seed matrix (H1-H5, V1-V8), logs/vlq_fivecolour/matrix.txt.

ab.arms: bare d5/b20 (no sidecar) vs d6/b20 + value leaf

value_play.note: ADOPTED 2026-08-14 after a paired A/B: vs bare d5/b20 with NO sidecar, this config is -0.0108 +/- 0.0025 turns (t=4.32, n=8 seeds x 1000 games, 7/8 seeds improve) and 2.68x cheaper in wall time (2.35 vs 6.30 s/game) while searching a depth deeper. A d5/d6/d7 sweep with the sidecar is flat (d6-d5=-0.0015 t=0.52; d7-d6=-0.0005 t=1.00, digest-identical on 3/4 seeds -- the search has converged by 6). Depth 6 from the 400x4 matrix: the value ladder SATURATES at V6 (V5-V6=+0.0075 t=2.35 real; V6-V7=+0.0013 t=1.43; V7-V8=+0.0006 t=1.00), and V6 matches the deepest usable heuristic (V6-H5=+0.0019+/-0.0011, t=1.76, indistinguishable) at 12.7 s/game vs H5's 844 -- 66x cheaper. V5 does NOT qualify: V5-H5=+0.0090+/-0.0031, t=2.91, genuinely worse. All matrix figures PAIRED on identical 25-game blocks; the table's row means are over unequal game sets (H5 is 375/400 on two seeds) and read -0.0001, which is an artifact -- matched sets give +0.0020. escalation_cap=5 is clamped to the deepest MEASURED heuristic depth (H6 was never generated on any deck), and is no shallower than the pre-adoption d5 play depth.
value_play.mull_gen_note: Mulligan GENERATION runs d2/b1, not the shipped d6/b20 (adopted 2026-08-18, user-approved). Measured fidelity-EQUAL to the prior d3/b3 gen setting by the 200-hand paired battery vs the shipped policy (rho 0.9891 vs 0.9906, dispersion 0.081 vs 0.067, 100% pairwise agreement) and result-identical on 240/240 proxy games across two seed blocks (re-verified 120/120 under the colour-exact engine), at 1.67x less work. The sidecar stays ATTACHED for gen: leaf-off at d2/b1 measured 1.57-2.20x slower on an idle box (fully separated). See docs/design/fivecolour-mullgen-labeller-sweep.md and fivecolour-gen-leaf-cost-wallclock.md. Affects generation only; play is unchanged.
